v1.say: Darling, you're back! And looking absolutely radioactive. Listen — the House archive found our OLDEST couture pattern. Pre-classical. Pre-EVERYTHING. It's yours for 150 bits, because you're you.

v1b.say: A piece of— it's a sixteen-by-sixteen GRID, darling, every square numbered, colors by code. Ancient couture is PIXEL ART and we simply called it embroidery. 150. Final.

v5.say: Wear it where the monks can see, won't you? They'll weep. It'll be DIVINE.

v3.say: There. Sixteen by sixteen, and when you fill the squares... it's a little blue circle. A world, darling. The FIRST world. Some seamstress copied the icon of everything and vanity preserved what faith couldn't parse.
